o.norm: Test Longley dataset against R. Data Source: J. Longley (1967) "An Appraisal of Least Squares Programs for the Electronic Computer from the Point of View of the User" Journal of the American Statistical Association, vol. 62. September, pp. 819-841. Data are from NIST: http://www.itl.nist.gov/div898/strd/lls/data/LINKS/DATA/Longley.dat

i.norm: The Longley regression dataset, stored as a flat row-major array of 16 observations with 7 variables each (112 values total). Data Source: J. Longley (1967) "An Appraisal of Least Squares Programs for the Electronic Computer from the Point of View of the User" Journal of the American Statistical Association, vol. 62. September, pp. 819-841. Data are from NIST: http://www.itl.nist.gov/div898/strd/lls/data/LINKS/DATA/Longley.dat
Expected 7x7 covariance matrix (also stored row-major), computed by R for the Longley dataset. This is what {@link Covariance} should reproduce.
Builds a matrix from a flat, row-major array by copying {@code nCols} consecutive values into each of the {@code nRows} rows.
Verifies that the covariance matrix computed for the Longley dataset matches the reference covariance matrix produced by R.
